title: Grisaia no Meikyuu: Takizono Basket-bu no Nama Cream Party!
justification: AniList 21312 (SPECIAL, 1 episode(s) from 2015-07-23) is AniDB 11008's special(s) S1, aired 2015-07-23. AniList's PARENT relation names AniList 21005, which anime-offline-database links to AniDB 11008, and the special's title (Takizono Basket-bu no Nama Cream Party!) matches an AniList title. The parent's node, as overlay/11008.json patches it, places S1 on TVDB 0x8 Crude Cream Party of the Takizono Basketball Club!, 2015-07-23. TMDB 61422, where the parent's node places the special(s) through the overlay's TMDB row, agrees: S0E8 Crude Cream Party of the Takizono Basketball Club! 2015-07-23.
